use_when.text: it serves as icon button and use in header, back office table row actions

stroke.text: actions in the app header, such as notifications and mail.
stroke.source: Figma 45:324 (IconButton component set › variant 45:323 description, repeated on every category=stroke variant)

default-fill.text: row actions in back-office tables, such as View or Edit.
default-fill.source: Figma 45:324 (IconButton component set › variant 224:908 description, repeated on every category=default-fill variant)

error-fill.text: destructive row actions in tables, such as Delete.
error-fill.source: Figma 45:324 (IconButton component set › variant 224:930 description, repeated on every category=error-fill variant)

disable.text: the action isn’t available for that item.
disable.source: Figma 45:324 (IconButton component-set description › paragraph 3, line "disable state")

placement.text: CardHeader’s slot stories render it in CardHeader’s header slot (`children`), with aria-label "Save job".

a11y.text: Renders a native <button>, with type="button" by default.
state="disable" sets the native disabled attribute.
The icon is aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false", and the button renders no text; other attributes, such as aria-label, pass through to the <button>.
